items.headline: Bitcoin Breaks Below $69,000 as Selloff Sets New Lows
items.summary: Ether, XRP and SOL also hit four-week lows on Coinbase, while bullish bets accounted for most tracked liquidations.

items.headline: XRP Ledger Foundation quantum roadmap: post-quantum account keys
items.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation published a design that would let account owners add a quantum-resistant ML-DSA-44 signing key and retire the old one, with no change to the base fee and a targeted transition around 2028; it is still a proposal, not an activated upgrade.

items.headline: Evernorth Holdings files final prospectus for resale of up to 73.7 million shares
items.summary: A final SEC prospectus dated Nov. 9 lets existing holders of Evernorth (Nasdaq: XRPN), the XRP treasury company, resell up to 73.7 million Class A shares; Evernorth receives no proceeds from those sales.

items.headline: XRP Ledger fixes a disclosed bug that let creation of new tokens
items.summary: CoinDesk reported that an XRP Ledger amendment took effect to close a loophole that could have let accounts authorized only to burn issued tokens also create new ones; the report said XRP’s own supply was not affected.

items.headline: XRPL developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
items.summary: CoinDesk reported that XRP Ledger developers proposed rule changes so restricted tokens cannot remain with accounts the issuer has not approved, except to be returned to the issuer.

items.headline: Ripple and Water.org Reach One Million People, Deepen Partnership to Drive Global Access to Safe Water
items.summary: Ripple and Water.org said their partnership has reached one million people and will expand to use Ripple Payments, RLUSD and digital-asset custody.

items.headline: Aviva's £50m tokenized fund: What changes for investors
items.summary: Aviva Investors launched a tokenized share class of its roughly £22 billion sterling liquidity fund on the XRP Ledger and invested £50 million of its own money in the new class.

items.headline: Ripple Reports Banner Year Approaching $900M Annual Product Revenue Run Rate, Signs Multi-Solution Partnerships with BNY, Robinhood and more
items.summary: At its Swell conference, Ripple said it is on track to finish 2026 with about $900 million in annualized product revenue and pointed to new institutional partnerships; the figure is the company’s own claim.

items.headline: Ripple and Coinbase Partner to Expand Access to Ripple USD
items.summary: Ripple and Coinbase announced that RLUSD can be traded and managed on Coinbase’s prime, exchange and retail platforms, with transfers supported on the XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum.
